header.title: Indicator
header.description: Corner mark that flags its child as featured. Wrap a card, tile or image. `variant` is the shape (`ribbon`, `fold` or `flag`) and `placement` is the corner.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the mark and its code. With `fold` the example uses a short word. Without `label`, it passes an explicit `aria-label` because the default name is fixed to `Featured`.
playground.label: Featured

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Wrap any surface. By default it's a `tertiary` `ribbon` on the top-end corner.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` sets the shape: `ribbon` is a diagonal band, `fold` a folded corner and `flag` a tab sitting on the corner.

placements.title: Placement
placements.description: `placement` picks the corner: `top-end` (default), `top-start`, `bottom-end` or `bottom-start`. `start` and `end` map to left and right.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` changes the background and text color: `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary` (default), `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info` or `neutral`.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It scales the ribbon width, fold, flag, text and icon.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: The mark is clipped with `radius`: `none`, `sm`, `md` (default), `lg` or `full`. Match the child's radius so the ribbon stays inside the corners.

fold.title: Fold
fold.description: `variant="fold"` shows the full text diagonally, so keep words short. It works on all four corners.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: `textStyle` applies a typography token (`caption`, `label`, `bodySm`, `code`, etc.) to a string `label` and removes the uppercase. A React node in `label` renders as-is; pass `aria-label` in that case.

card.title: With a card
card.description: `block` stretches the indicator to the container width, handy with cards. The default `radius` (`md`) matches `Card`.

texts.title: Coastal retreat
texts.subtitle: Available this weekend
texts.body: Sea-view cabin with breakfast included and free cancellation up to 48 hours before.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: `icon` adds a glyph before the text. Without `label` a star is shown; pass `aria-label` to name the mark.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: `offset` moves the mark away from the corner, in pixels. Useful when the child has its own border or padding.

toggle.title: Show and hide
toggle.description: `isInvisible` removes the mark without unmounting the content. Use it to show the mark based on state without layout shifts.

header.description: API reference for the React Indicator component: props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Indicator accepts <div> attributes, which go to the root along with ref, except role and aria-label, which go to the mark layer. style is merged with --gem-indicator-offset when you pass offset.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The mark layer has role="img". Change it with role.
a11y.name: The accessible name is aria-label or, if missing, the string label.
a11y.fallback: Without a string label or aria-label, the name is "Featured". Pass an explicit aria-label for other languages.
a11y.custom: If label is a React node, it isn't used as the name: pass aria-label.
a11y.decorative: The icon has aria-hidden. With isInvisible the layer is removed from the DOM and not announced.
a11y.surface: The mark comes after the child in the DOM, so it's read after the content. It has pointer-events: none and doesn't block clicks.
a11y.contrast: Each tone sets a text color with good contrast. If you change --gem-indicator-bg or --gem-indicator-fg, check it reaches 4.5:1: the text is small.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Sets the sizing variables.
rules.block: Applied with `block`. Takes the full width.
rules.hasLabel: Applied when there's a `label`. In `fold` it enlarges the corner and rotates the text.
rules.layer: Layer that clips the mark with the radius. Holds the role and name. Receives `classNames.layer`.
rules.label: Text of a string `label`. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.slot: Wrapper of a React node `label`. Receives `classNames.label`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Indicator's own variables. The tone, size and radius classes set them, so use `.gem-indicator.your-class` to override them.

items.--gem-indicator-offset: Distance from the corner. Set by `offset`.
items.--gem-indicator-radius: Radius used to clip the mark.
items.--gem-indicator-inset: Ribbon distance from the edge in `ribbon`.
items.--gem-indicator-overhang: How far the ribbon overhangs in `ribbon` (negative value).

items.--gem-palette-neutral-{0|950}: Text color: white or near-black depending on the tone.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.children: Surface to highlight: card, tile or image.
items.radius: Radius used to clip the mark. Match the child.
items.offset: Extra distance from the corner, in pixels.
items.label: Mark text or a custom node. In `fold` use a short word.
items.textStyle: Typography token for a string `label`. Ignored when `label` is a node.
items.icon: Glyph before the text. Without `label`, a star is shown.
items.isInvisible: Hides the mark without unmounting the child.
items.aria-label: Accessible name of the mark. Defaults to the string `label` or `"Featured"`.
